blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Kacey dela Rosa will lead Gilas Pilipinas’ own bid for a medal finish in women’s 3×3 U-23 basketball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Tuesday. Dela Rosa teams up with Kennan Ka, Amyah Espanol and Maria Pasilang as Gilas plays Mongolia and Macau in Group C at Kinjo Futo Station Square.
